items.title: JPMorgan and Mastercard back Seattle startup Firmly’s bet on AI shopping agents
items.summary: Firmly raised $15 million to expand software that lets online retailers sell through AI shopping assistants, marketplaces and other channels without building a separate integration for each one. The company also launched Ask Agent, an AI shopping assistant for retailers' own websites. Read More

items.title: Trevor Noah on AI
items.summary: Trevor Noah told an audience at Boston's Museum of Science on Oct. 19 that the real question about AI and jobs is the "following distance" between old jobs disappearing and new ones arriving. Oren Etzioni, who joined him onstage, recounts Noah's views on why AI struggles with comedy, why in-person community matters and why AI only seems to go deep. Read More

items.title: Ananas: A Networked Audio System for Distributed Spatial Audio Applications
items.summary: Spatial audio has an accessibility problem. Largescale spatial and immersive audio installations remain costly and exclusive, with high barriers to entry. We propose ''Ananas,'' a networked audio system consisting of network protocols, control software and microcontroller firmware, with the aim of rendering spatial audio applications accessible…

items.title: The Agent Board: Kanban for Machines; Durable Coordination for Agents That Outlive the Conversation
items.summary: Harnesses for large language models have converged on a single-threaded shape: one agent, one history, one machine, one sitting. That shape fails work that spans many agents, outlives any one model call, or waits on systems that are not agents. We describe the Agent Board, the coordination substrate in the Corvic harness.
